REFERRAL LETTER
Date: 11/26/2026
Patient Name: Fiona Turner
DOB: 06/22/1958
MRN: MRN-63292

To: Cardiology Clinic Intake
From: Dr. Evan Smith, Kensington Family Practice

Dear Colleague,

Reason for referral: Evaluation of breathlessness on exertion.

Fiona Turner is a 68-year-old woman at Kensington Family Practice with hypertension, type 2 diabetes mellitus, and osteoarthritis.

Over the past three months, she has developed gradually increasing breathlessness when walking uphill or climbing stairs. This now limits her usual walks. She denies breathlessness at rest and reports no recent respiratory illness.

I am writing to request cardiology assessment of her breathlessness on exertion.

Thank you for seeing this patient.

Dr. Evan Smith
Kensington Family Practice
